name: MQTT → existing broker 192.168.1.109 | Topic: weather/lelystad/forecast | Runs on deploy + every hour
info:
Sources:
1. OpenWeatherMap  — 3h/5day free tier, key pre-filled
2. Open-Meteo      — free, no key, 1h native
3. MET Norway (Yr) — free, no key, 1h native
4. KNMI station 269— free API key pre-filled, current obs only
5. Buienradar rain — free, 5-min radar for next 2h

The KNMI node makes 3 sequential HTTPS calls internally (file list → temp URL → download).
It contributes observed data to the current-hour slot only.
